MV DUNLIN GATE, Mundra to Gijon

Owners decline to transit the Red Sea under the war risks clause, after this morning's security warning. Please send alternative voyage orders; we suggest via the Cape of Good Hope.

Best regards,
Marine department
Owner's vessel technical management (Dunlin Gate Shipping, fictional)
